ideas.name: any warning with the two VWAPs sloping apart
ideas.why: the overnight-inclusive VWAP rising while the day's falls (or the reverse): the day's traders are undoing the overnight's position, a rotation where turns pay

ideas.name: any warning with volume rising over the hour
ideas.why: the last 15 minutes' relative volume 1.3x the 45 before: participation arriving, which usually carries the move on, so turns fail

ideas.name: any warning just off a round 25, calling away
ideas.why: the level study's nearest miss (round 25s): a warning calling away from one touched in the last 5 minutes

ideas.name: Friday afternoon warning toward the nearest round 100
ideas.why: into the weekly options close, dealers hedging the big strikes pull price toward them: Friday after 12:00 CT, a warning calling toward the nearest round hundred
